name: Pawn Shop
description: During the Tang Dynasty, the development of the market was quite mature, with numerous shops closely linked to each other, forming a criss-crossing bustling streets. The pawn shop is located in Datang Street. When people are in trouble or need money urgently, they will mortgage various items in exchange for working capital. The design of Pinku Pawnshop incorporates the architectural features of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. It is antique, gorgeous and magnificent, and authentically reproduces the life style at that time. In addition, there are a series of buildings such as Rouge Shop and Fengman Building, which will take you to appreciate the prosperous atmosphere of the Tang Dynasty.
